title: Grateful Dead Live at Gaelic Park on 1971-08-26
lineage: aud 5" reel masters>7" reel @ 3.75 ips, dolby b technics rs-1506>teac an-180>hd-p2 24/96> hd>cd wave>adobe 2.0 16/44>flac

ai_review.summary: A great outdoor audience recording with clear vocals and bright guitar solos, highlighted by Pigpen’s rare 'Empty Pages' performance and high‑energy spunky vibe.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers praise this 1971 outdoor AUD as surprisingly clear and lively, noting loud vocals, bright guitar work and only a slight ‘thick’ outdoor coloration. The show is described as hot and spunky, with Pigpen’s second‑ever rendition of “Empty Pages” standing out as a special treat.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently positive 4‑star reviews highlight strong musical energy and an above‑average audience recording; limited to two detailed reviews, so confidence is medium.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear and loud vocals with bright guitar solos; occasional chatter/cheers add ambience. Slightly 'thick' sound typical of an outdoor setting, but overall surprisingly crisp for an AUD.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Outdoor hot show with spunky energy; treats scattered throughout the set, keeping momentum high.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Bright guitar solos noted as clear and lively.
band_member_comments.Keys: Pigpen sings 'Empty Pages', his last show for three months and only the second performance ever.
